title: Ease tight hips
headline: Ease tight hips
detail: A simple stretch for sitting-down days
caption:
Hips feel stiff when you stand up after a long sit? You're not alone. 🪑

Sitting for hours, in the car, at a desk or on the sofa on a cold evening, keeps the front of the hips short and tight. Over time that can pull on the lower back.

Try this kneeling hip stretch:

1. Kneel on a mat or folded towel, then step your right foot forward so both knees make a right angle.
2. Stand tall, and gently tuck your tailbone under until you feel a stretch at the front of the left hip.
3. Hold for five slow breaths, then swap sides.

Keep it gentle. You should feel a stretch, never pain.

We use simple moves like this in our Mat Pilates classes in Clitheroe, for men and women at every level.

Save this for your next sitting-down day.
